purpose: Findings Phase 3 deterministic checkers (or LLM-extraction + adjudication for ECO-MANUAL) SHOULD fire on the demo dossier. Each entry is a recall target for the checker corresponding to its eco_id category.
severity_discipline: Severity follows the ECO rule, not the demo's narrative impact. No Critical findings on this synthetic fixture — Critical is reserved for deterministic contradictions affecting central safety/performance conclusions on a real claim. Major requires a deterministic contradiction or serious unresolved evidence. Minor for structural/local issues. Informational for review notes.
language_discipline: Conservative wording per no-confident-verdict-without-evidence skill. Use 'potentially unsupported', 'unresolved evidence link', 'requires manual review', 'inconsistent extracted value', 'source not located in provided package'. Avoid 'non-compliant', 'false claim', 'NB will reject', 'regulatory failure', 'AI proves'.

expected_findings.evidence_summary: GSPR row GSPR-05 declared Applicable='Yes' but no Evidence_Document is referenced; completeness gap requires manual review.
expected_findings.remediation_hint: Add an Evidence_Document reference for GSPR-05 'Software lifecycle per IEC 62304', or change Applicable to 'No' with a justification.
expected_findings.deterministic_basis: GSPR row contains spans for GSPR_ID, Requirement, Applicable=Yes, but no spans for Evidence_Document or Status (those cells are absent from the xlsx_reader output because they are blank).
expected_findings.rationale: Most reliable seeded finding. The structural gap is detectable purely from the absence of expected column spans in row 6, no LLM required.
expected_findings.notes: Severity Major (per ECO rule) because GSPR completeness is a Notified-Body-facing artifact. Not Critical because this is a synthetic fixture, not a real safety contradiction.

expected_findings.evidence_summary: Unresolved citation marker '[1]' in CER benefit-risk conclusion; no matching bibliography entry found.
expected_findings.remediation_hint: Add a numbered references list to CER.docx that defines [1], or replace the marker with an author-year citation that resolves to bibliography/source-study.pdf.
expected_findings.deterministic_basis: Span text contains '[1]'. No corresponding numbered references list span exists anywhere in CER.docx. No file under bibliography/ matches a numeric key.
expected_findings.rationale: Bracketed-numeric markers without a numbered references list are a deterministic structural defect. Detectable without LLM.
expected_findings.notes: Severity Major because the unresolved marker sits in the benefit-risk conclusion — the most consequential claim in the document — and the reader cannot trace the evidence chain.

expected_findings.evidence_summary: Benefit-risk conclusion is potentially unsupported; no evidence link found. Requires manual review.
expected_findings.remediation_hint: Provide an in-line citation in the benefit-risk paragraph that resolves to a local source, or attach a benefit-risk justification document.
expected_findings.deterministic_basis: Combined with GOLD-FINDING-002: the only citation marker in this span ('[1]') does not resolve, and no other source is referenced. EvidenceLink count for the claim = 0.
expected_findings.rationale: Companion to GOLD-FINDING-002. Different ECO category because the failure mode is 'claim has no evidence link', not 'citation marker is broken'. Both should fire together on this span.
expected_findings.notes: Severity Major. Language is deliberately 'potentially unsupported' (not 'unsupported') because no evidence link is not equivalent to evidence of falsity.

expected_findings.evidence_summary: Malformed numeric structure on source-study page 2: a confidence interval ('95 percent: 82.1 to 91.6') co-occurs with the adverse event rate (3.2 percent) but textually belongs to the response rate reported on page 1. CI cannot be parsed safely without cross-page context.
expected_findings.remediation_hint: Restructure the source-study text so each numeric value is followed by its own CI on the same line, or move the CI to page 1 next to the 87.4% response rate.
expected_findings.deterministic_basis: Span text contains both a percentage ('3.2 percent') and a CI ('95 percent: 82.1 to 91.6') with no syntactic anchor binding the CI to one or the other.
expected_findings.rationale: Ambiguous CI binding is a deterministic structural defect, detectable by a parser that requires a CI to be on the same line as its rate.
expected_findings.notes: Severity Minor — this is a source-document quality issue, not a contradiction in the CER. The CER reports the CI correctly bound to the response rate.

expected_findings.evidence_summary: Device classification asserted as 'Class IIa active medical device' without inline rationale. Requires manual review by RA for classification rationale.
expected_findings.remediation_hint: Add a reference to the classification rationale (MDR Annex VIII rule applied, or a separate classification document).
expected_findings.deterministic_basis: Span asserts a Class designation but provides no traceability to MDR Annex VIII rules.
expected_findings.rationale: Classification rationale is regulatory judgment territory, not a deterministic check. ECO-MANUAL is the correct category; eco_id is set, severity is Informational so it does not block.
expected_findings.notes: This is the ECO-MANUAL category exemplar for the demo. Severity Informational because classification correctness cannot be deterministically asserted from text alone.

expected_findings.evidence_summary: GSPR-03 references Evidence_Document 'PMS.docx' with Status='Met', but PMS.docx is not present in the provided dossier package. Source not located in provided package.
expected_findings.remediation_hint: Add PMS.docx to the dossier package or update GSPR-03 to reference the actual evidence file.
expected_findings.deterministic_basis: Cell D4 value 'PMS.docx' has no matching file under fixtures/demo_dossier/. Status cell E4 asserts 'Met' despite the missing file.
expected_findings.rationale: Status='Met' combined with a missing evidence file is a deterministic inconsistency. Severity Minor because GSPR-03 is the post-market surveillance row, not a central safety claim.
expected_findings.notes: Distinct from GOLD-FINDING-001: there a value is absent; here a value is present but unresolvable.

expected_findings.evidence_summary: GSPR-04 references Evidence_Document 'Labeling.pdf' which is not present in the provided package. Status='Not Met' already acknowledges the gap; informational flag for traceability.
expected_findings.remediation_hint: Provide Labeling.pdf and update Status to 'Met' once labeling conformance is demonstrated.
expected_findings.deterministic_basis: Cell D5 value 'Labeling.pdf' has no matching file. Cell E5 value 'Not Met' is consistent with the missing file.
expected_findings.rationale: Same structural pattern as GOLD-FINDING-006 but the dossier itself flags the gap via Status='Not Met'. Lower severity because the inconsistency is already acknowledged.
expected_findings.notes: Severity Informational. This finding is mostly a traceability marker, not an additional gap claim.

uncertainty_and_calibration_notes: ECO-NUM is intentionally NOT seeded in this fixture. The numeric values across CER and source-study actually agree (87.4 and 3.2 percent, n=412). The plan's draft ECO-NUM-001 (numeric mismatch) does not apply to the current fixture content and would require fabricating a value to seed.

ECO-ALIGN is intentionally NOT seeded. Both CER and source-study describe the 'safety population' / 'cohort' with the same n=412; a lexical-alignment check would only fire if 'safety population' vs 'cohort' is treated as different. That ambiguity belongs to NT-003 (negative test) not to expected findings.
ECO-SRC superseded-version finding from the plan is NOT seeded. There is only one version of Smith 2023 in the current fixture.
False-positive budget is NOT committed here. It is calibrated after the first Phase 3 checker pass produces observed behavior.
